description: Rental property investment calculator from your numbers: monthly mortgage payment (amortising), net operating income, cap rate, gross rental yield, monthly and annual cash flow, cash-on-cash return, debt service coverage ratio (DSCR), break-even occupancy and the 1% rule check. Any currency. Standard formulas; it does not look up prices or rents. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

closingCosts.description: One-off purchase costs added to cash invested (default 0)

expensesMonthly.description: Monthly operating costs: tax, insurance, maintenance, management, HOA (default 0)
